articles.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
articles.summary: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models, but API users can dodge the mark on two of them by tweaking a single sampling parameter.

articles.title: datasette-llm 0.1a9
articles.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin.

articles.title: The Movement Physics of Super Mario Bros – Behind the Code
articles.summary: In this episode of Behind the Code, we look into the movement physics – the motion – of Mario in the original Super Mario Bros.

articles.title: Building an ADS-B Receiver For Less Than You Think
articles.summary: If you’ve ever wondered about the planes flying above your head, you could always listen in to ADS-B transmissions to learn more about them. [thefatmoop] has built a rig to do just that, and it comes in under $50 in parts.

articles.title: Here’s how the new MacBook Pro and macOS 27 are optimized for touch
articles.summary: Apple just unveiled the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR , its first MacBook with a touch display. While Apple already added a handful of touch optimizations to macOS 27 Golden Gate earlier this year, there’s also a number of new optimizations that were unveiled alongside the new MacBook Pro.

articles.title: Samsung mercilessly mocks iPhone Duo ‘crackgate’ in Galaxy Z Fold 8 ads [Video]
articles.summary: Samsung isn’t holding back when it comes to the iPhone Duo’s messy start. In new ads, the company mocks iPhone Duo’s “crackgate” with a push for customers to buy the Galaxy Z Fold 8 instead, and there’s not an ounce of subtlety here.

articles.title: Fightbox R10 Pro Full Review: Spinner, Trackball, 0.7ms Arcade Stick
articles.summary: Here’s a full review of my new favorite arcade stick: The R10 Pro from Fightbox that includes a trackball and spinner. It averages less than 1 millisecond of lag via one USB output and is compatible with basically everything.

articles.title: Huge PalmOS Development Archive Goes Online, Thanks to Personal Backups
articles.summary: This led [Aaron] to dust off and publish his substantial personal archive of development tools, source code, documentation, and more all related to his years of working with Palm OS in the early days of mobile computing.

articles.title: 8-Bit NES CDROM Expansion Concept
articles.summary: I love projects like this, as while it’s definitely not practical, it’s a lot of fun. And as Tito pointed out in the video, it would have technically been possible in the NES’s heyday, as CDROM addons for consoles had just started with the PC Engine CDROM.

articles.title: Pixel 6 postmortem: How Google’s flawed reboot defined future hardware [Video]
articles.summary: So with that in mind, this is the Google Pixel 6 and 6 Pro: the good, the bad, the ugly, and how this turbulent reboot shaped the future of Pixel.

articles.title: Google says Android Auto video apps are still ‘coming soon’ as deadline nears
articles.summary: In a brief update at its latest dev conference, Google says that video and browser apps for Android Auto are still “coming soon,” with the company’s self-imposed deadline approaching quickly.

articles.title: Five more classics join the GOG Preservation Program
articles.summary: In addition to publishing more games , the GOG Preservation Program has expanded again with another five classic games added. Hopefully GOG will actually deliver on the confirmed GOG Galaxy for Linux , until then you can use the Heroic Launcher .

articles.title: Epic Games Launcher Preview updated to fix logins on some Linux systems
articles.summary: Numerous users reported issues with the system keyring, which caused the Epic Games Launcher Preview for Linux in some cases to not even open, and for others just preventing logins at all - that should all now be solved.

articles.title: Jagex are now publishing Melvor Idle 2 as an official RuneScape game
articles.summary: Melvor Idle 2 (now Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure) massively expands on the very popular original game and now has publishing help. It's all a bit more official now, with it becoming an actual standalone RuneScape game.

articles.title: System76 tease the new mini Thelio Prime Desktop coming in November
articles.summary: System76 have been busy cooking, with a teaser of their new mini Thelio Prime Desktop that will be launching November 18th. They didn't seem to send any press notice on this (or they just skipped us), but I did spot System76 founder Carl Richell posting about it on Bluesky .

articles.title: 14 New Things Your iPhone Can Do in iOS 27.2
articles.summary: iOS 27.2 is available to download to your device now via Settings ➝ General ➝ Software Update. Note that some features may not be available in all regions or on all iPhone models.

articles.title: OpenShot 4.1 Released With Auto-Optimize, CLI Automation & ARM64 Linux Builds
articles.summary: OpenShot is closing out the month of October by releasing OpenShot 4.1 as the latest major feature release for this useful open-source video editing solution.

articles.title: Sanket lets you redesign GNOME’s date menu and Quick Settings
articles.summary: Sanket is a GNOME Shell extension that lets you rejig how the desktop’s date menu, calendar, notifications and Quick Settings look and behave – and then some.

articles.title: Linux Mint Developing New Apps For Terminal & System Monitoring
articles.summary: Linux Mint is out with their October 2026 status report to outline various initiatives they have underway in their lead-up to the Linux Mint 27 stable release happening on/around Christmas.

articles.title: New Linux 7.4 Feature For Reducing AI Noise Already Reverted Due To A "Crazy Beast"
articles.summary: A new feature merged last week for Linux 7.4 to help reduce AI/LLM generated noise from invalid/irrelevant testing configurations is now reverted due to a 'crazy beast' in the VFIO subsystem.
